## Code Review

This pull request adds support for parsing locales with a script subtag (such as `zh-Hant-TW`) to correctly load Traditional Chinese translations while maintaining the formatting locale. A test case was added to verify this behavior. The reviewer suggested recursively calling `parseLocale` with the reconstructed `catalogLocale` to ensure consistent fallback behavior when the reconstructed locale is not directly supported.

review_comments.body:
![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

If the reconstructed `catalogLocale` (e.g., `es-MX` from `es-Hant-MX`) is not directly present in `supportedLocales`, the current implementation falls back to `DEFAULT_LOCALE` (`en-US`). However, if the user had passed `es-MX` directly, it would have correctly matched `es-ES` via `matchLocale` (which falls back to the 2-letter language code).

To ensure consistent fallback behavior for all language-script-region locales, we should recursively call `parseLocale` with the reconstructed `catalogLocale`. This allows it to go through the standard matching and 2-letter fallback logic.

```suggestion
        return parseLocale(catalogLocale, supportedLocales);
```
